rows: It was snowing on the road.
The snow came in the night, quietly, as if it did not want to wake anyone.
It was very cold and white.
Where there had been potholes, there was only white, smooth as a page.
A single car crept round the bend.

blocks.h: Plan the rewrite in five lines

parts.text: 1 Wide: the road at dawn, untouched (image: a blank page)
2 Lens: one detail: a bus shelter roof heavy with snow
3 Movement: a car, two dark lines like words
4 Sound: almost none; then a door, a shovel
5 Return: by noon the page is written over

parts.label: Why it works
parts.text: A five-line plan with a sustained image

keywords.def: communicating effectively and imaginatively, adapting form, tone and register for purpose and audience (20 marks in Section C)
a range of vocabulary and sentence structures, with accurate spelling, punctuation and grammar (10 marks)
find exactly what is holding a piece back

questions.q: Write your two AO4 targets and one AO5 target
questions.a: For example: AO4: sustain one image; control the ending. AO5: no comma splices.

questions.q: Core: rewrite the first two paragraphs of your Spring 2 piece, applying your targets
Extend: write your five-line plan for tomorrow's full timed rewrite
Stretch: list three AO5 upgrades you will use (a colon, a short sentence, a precise verb)
Which target will lift a mid-level description most?
options: Add more adjectives to every noun
Build the piece around one sustained image
questions.a: C) Build the piece around one sustained image. A sustained image gives control and structure; extra adjectives or length do not.
